hero_kpi_rationale_en: Residential revenue is a key sector metric, affected by housing investment cycles and power outage activity, demonstrating the cyclical sensitivity of the product portfolio

ai_positioning.summary_en: Generac Holdings Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 10-K report. There is no indication of AI use or development in its core business activities.

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Investment Cycles
risks.summary_en: Residential and commercial investment cycles, interest rate variations, and commodity prices can reduce demand for products.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is exposed to residential and commercial investment cycles, interest rate fluctuations, commodity prices, and global economic conditions. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Policies
risks.summary_en: Tariffs since Q1 2025 are creating inflationary pressures, reducing margins, and decreasing demand for certain products.
risks.score_rationale_en: Since Q1 2025, additional tariffs are impacting costs and margins. The company has implemented price increases that reduce demand. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependency
risks.summary_en: Supply chain disruptions and commodity price fluctuations can reduce production capacity and margins.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company is heavily dependent on the supply chain, exposed to disruptions and price fluctuations for raw materials and components. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Commodity and Component Price Volatility
risks.summary_en: Fluctuations in prices for raw materials, electronic components, and battery cells impact costs and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale_en: Fluctuations in steel, copper, aluminum, and electronic component prices. Recent acquisitions increase exposure to volatile battery cells. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Competitive Risks
risks.summary_en: Competition can reduce sales, market share, and profit margins.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company operates in competitive markets (residential, commercial, industrial, data centers). Mentioned in Item 1 Business.

risks.title: Debt Structure Dependency
risks.summary_en: High debt structure can impact financial flexibility and the ability to invest in development.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company has significant debt with credit obligations. In July 2025, Term Loan A and Revolving Credit Facility were amended. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A Note 12.

risks.title: Geopolitical Instability and Currency Fluctuations
risks.summary_en: Geopolitical instability and currency fluctuations can impact sales and financial results from international operations.
risks.score_rationale_en: International operations expose the company to regional conflicts, foreign exchange risks, and political uncertainties. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.

risks.title: Impact of Renewable Energy Mandates and Tax Incentive Changes
risks.summary_en: Changes in renewable energy mandates and investment tax credits can reduce demand for solar and storage systems.
risks.score_rationale_en: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) of July 2025 accelerated the phase-out of certain investment tax credits, negatively impacting the solar storage market. Mentioned in Item 7 MD&A.
